\caption{Track~3 trajectory metrics, descriptive, not registered (\texttt{scripts/t3\_metrics.py}, from stored evaluation episodes only; no new runs). Rows pool the arm's seeds (models column). A turn without a parseable call ends the episode and is not a call. \emph{Calls}, \emph{turns}: per episode, all episodes. \emph{Wall s/ep}: the run's evaluation wall time divided by its episodes (range over runs); each run is one batched vLLM job, so this is throughput time per episode on the named GPU, not per-request latency, and it depends on the GPU, batch size and output length. Scripted policies (B0, B4) have no model turns or timed runs. \emph{Lower block}: the only measured per-episode latency (batch 1, one task at a time, greedy, 40 \texttt{proc\_dev} episodes, \texttt{scripts/latency\_proc.py}); of the models above, only the warm start's weights were timed this way (they are the AD-C1 warm start and arm A's base). D, Dw and Dw\_aug have no batch-1 measurement.}
